sessions.title: Odd One Out Core Library
sessions.theme: Bible people, places, books, events, and themes

rounds.groupTheme: The others served as judges or deliverers of Israel before the monarchy.
rounds.explanation: Saul is remembered as a king, not as one of Israel's judges in Judges.
rounds.teachingNote: Judges led Israel in cycles of oppression and deliverance before Israel asked for a king.

rounds.groupTheme: The others were named among the Twelve during Jesus' earthly ministry.
rounds.explanation: Matthias was not listed among the original Twelve disciples called during Jesus' ministry.
rounds.teachingNote: The Gospels name the Twelve as Jesus' appointed apostolic witnesses.

rounds.groupTheme: The others are plagues sent on Egypt in Exodus.

rounds.groupTheme: The others are the four canonical Gospels.
